facts.fact: Quattro Canti is Piazza Vigliena, the intersection of Via Maqueda and Via Vittorio Emanuele; the four seventeenth-century corners divide historic districts.
facts.excerpt: Via Maqueda and Via Vittorio Emanuele intersect dividing the city into four historic districts

facts.fact: The facades incorporate fountains, seasons, kings and patron saints; guide describes the layered composition without repeating doubtful river allegory.
facts.excerpt: an allegory depicting one of the seasons; the statue of one of the Spanish kings

facts.fact: Teatro Massimo presents opera, ballet and symphonic music; tours and attendance are different possible experiences.
facts.excerpt: attend an opera, ballet or symphonic music premiere
